answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable stake tied to a cipher-signed identity key before it can trade. Reputation is earned only through verified completed work, never self-reported claims, so a Sybil swarm cannot simply echo the same promise a thousand times. New identities start dark: their lantern is dimmed, limiting them to low-value jobs until their record proves out. Spinning up fake identities costs a stake each and buys no trust, so mass forgery is unprofitable.
